items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: I played with those, you know, see. For a little while. Who was in the band with Oak?

ctx.x: Any others you want to mention on guitar, banjo, drums or bass?

Yeah, Vic Gaspar. Yeah, Vic Gaspar. Albert Glenny. And Oak Gaspar. Yeah, Oak. I mean Oak. Yeah. Vic Gaspar. Oak, yeah. Oak, yeah. And Albert Glenny. I played with those, you know, see. For a little while. Who was in the band with Oak? What band was that band? It must have been with Magnum, I guess.
I wasn't sure it was. Imperial band. Buddy Johnson. I don't know which band. He played one of them dance bands too.
